v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Prophétæ prædicavérunt * nasci Salvatórem de Vírgine María.
text.en: The Prophets foretold * that the Saviour should be born of the Virgin Mary.

text.la: Spíritus * Dómini super me, evangelizáre paupéribus misit me.
text.en: The Spirit of the Lord * is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the Gospel to the poor.

text.la: Propter Sion * non tacébo, donec egrediátur ut splendor iustus eius.
text.en: For Zion's sake * will I not hold my peace, until her Righteous One goeth forth as brightness.

text.la: Ecce, véniet Dóminus, * ut sédeat cum princípibus, et sólium glóriæ téneat.
text.en: Behold, the Lord cometh, * to sit among princes, and to inherit the throne of glory.

text.la: Annuntiáte * pópulis, et dícite: Ecce, Deus Salvátor noster véniet.
text.en: Tell it out among the people, * and say: Behold, God, our Saviour cometh.

text.la: Veníte, et ascendámus ad montem Dómini, et ad domum Dei Iacob, et docébit nos vias suas, et ambulábimus in sémitis eius: quia de Sion exíbit lex, et verbum Dómini de Ierúsalem.
text.en: Come and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob, and he will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall come forth from Sion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Missus est Gábriel * Angelus ad Maríam Vírginem desponsátam Ioseph.
text.en: The angel Gabriel * was sent to Mary, a virgin espoused to Joseph.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut redemptiónis nostræ ventúra solémnitas et præséntis nobis vitæ subsídia cónferat, et ætérnæ beatitúdinis prǽmia largiátur.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, Almighty God, that the solemn Feast of our redemption, which is now at hand, may both help us in the life which now is, and further us toward the attaining of thine eternal joy in that which is to come.
